bifrost: No 3D math API. 2D transforms only: springboard/ui/src/geometry.rs, springboard/src/shell/browser/style/values.rs (Transform2D), springboard/src/shell/window_fx.rs (2D scale and slide)
summary: Spatial is a 3D math library (vectors, points, rotations, poses, affine and projective transforms, rays, coordinate spaces). BifrOSt has no 3D primitives in the SDK, the UI kit or the renderer; its transforms are 2D (affine matrices for the browser engine and scale/slide window effects). A desktop app has little use for 3D math, so this is low priority.

features.apple: Vector3D, Vector3DFloat, Point3D, Point3DFloat, Size3D, Rect3D, Axis3D
features.bifrost: none found; grep for Vector3, Point3D, Vec3 and Mat4 in springboard/ returns no SDK or ui types (only shader vec3 literals in springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs and springboard/wm/src/glass.rs)
features.note: no 3D value types exposed to apps

features.apple: Rotation3D, Rotation3DFloat, RotationAxis3D, Pose3D, ScaledPose3D, EulerAnglesFloat

gaps: No 3D vector, point or size types in the SDK (bifrost_app) or the UI kit (bifrost_ui).
No 4x4 affine or projective transform; the renderer and layout use 2D matrices only.
No pose, rotation (quaternion or Euler) or ray types for picking.
Views have no per-view transform or coordinate space conversion (springboard/sdk/src/view/mod.rs).
Window effects are 2D scale and slide (springboard/src/shell/window_fx.rs); no perspective or 3D flip.
